name: INTEL CORPORATION
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/intc-20231230.htm; https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/intc/employees/
notes: Intel's FY2023 10-K reports 124,800 employees as of Dec. 30, 2023 (131,900 in 2022), headquartered in Santa Clara, CA. The recipient is the public parent itself; the grants fund the New Albany (Licking County) fab project.

name: ULTIUM CELLS
parent: Ultium Cells LLC (50/50 joint venture of General Motors Co. and LG Energy Solution)
emp_source: https://www.tribtoday.com/news/local-news/2022/03/ultium-charges-up-hiring/; https://www.jobsohio.com/newsroom/ohio-success/ultium-cells
notes: Ultium Cells is a JV formed in Dec. 2019 by GM (Detroit, MI) and LG Chem/LG Energy Solution (South Korea); the Lordstown plant itself had about 200 workers at end of 2021, 600+ at end of 2022 and a 1,100+ target for 2023. Bucket reflects the two owners (GM alone reports well over 100,000 employees in its 10-K); no single ultimate parent, so a skeptic could argue for either owner or a 'Korea' HQ.

name: THE SHERWIN-WILLIAMS COMPANY
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/89800/000008980024000033/shw-20231231.htm
notes: FY2023 10-K: 64,088 employees worldwide at Dec. 31, 2023, about 75% in the US; headquartered in Cleveland, founded there in 1866. Grants support the new downtown Cleveland HQ and Brecksville R&D center; JobsOhio metrics list 3,524 retained jobs.

name: UNIVERSITY OF CINCINNATI
parent: University of Cincinnati (State of Ohio public university)
emp_source: https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/development.ohio.gov/research/obs/Ohio-Major-Employers-Report.pdf; https://www.uc.edu/news/articles/2022/04/working-at-the-university-of-cincinnati.html
notes: Ohio Department of Development's Dec. 2022 Major Employers report lists University of Cincinnati at 10,512 Ohio employees (UC Health separately at 10,118); UC's own 2022 release says over 15,000 employees. Grants are Spec Development (OSIP) money for the Cincinnati Innovation District, not an operating business.

name: THE OHIO STATE UNIVERSITY
parent: The Ohio State University (State of Ohio public university)
emp_source: https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/development.ohio.gov/research/obs/Ohio-Major-Employers-Report.pdf; https://irp.osu.edu/sites/default/files/documents/2024/01/2023-24-Statistical-Summary_0.pdf
notes: Ohio Department of Development's Dec. 2022 Major Employers report lists Ohio State University and Medical Center at 35,656 Ohio employees, fifth-largest employer in the state. No JobsOhio project-metrics row matched; the grants are likely innovation-district and research commitments (Columbus).

name: THE CLEVELAND CLINIC FOUNDATION
emp_source: https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/development.ohio.gov/research/obs/Ohio-Major-Employers-Report.pdf; https://newsroom.clevelandclinic.org/2025/01/27/state-of-the-clinic-in-2024-cleveland-clinic-serves-most-patients-in-its-history
notes: Cleveland Clinic reports 82,600 caregivers worldwide for 2024; the Dec. 2022 Ohio Major Employers report ranks it Ohio's largest employer at 56,986 in-state. Form 5500 shows 71,821 plan participants in 2023. Nonprofit 501(c)(3) health system, not an operating business; JobsOhio metrics show 17,745 retained jobs.

name: BECHTEL OIL GAS AND CHEMICALS INC
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bechtel; https://www.heraldstaronline.com/news/local-news/2020/02/jobsohio-investing-another-20m-toward-proposed-cracker-plant/
notes: Bechtel Oil, Gas & Chemicals is the Houston-based unit of privately held Bechtel Group, which moved its HQ from San Francisco to Reston, VA by end of 2018 (EDGAR lists a CA address from older filings). The $20M paid in FY2020 was JobsOhio's site-work money for the PTTGC/Daelim Belmont County ethane cracker, routed to Bechtel as contractor. Bechtel's exact 2020 headcount was not found in its 2020 report; ~55,000 employees in 2022 per Wikipedia, and Bechtel was founded in California in 1898.

name: AMGEN INC
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/318154/000031815424000011/amgn-20231231.htm; https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/amgn/employees/
notes: Amgen's FY2023 10-K lists Thousand Oaks, CA as principal executive office; approximately 26,700 staff at end of 2023 (28,000 in 2024). Grants support the New Albany biomanufacturing plant; JobsOhio metrics show 400 retained jobs.

name: UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS HEALTH SYSTEM INC
emp_source: https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/development.ohio.gov/research/obs/Ohio-Major-Employers-Report.pdf; https://www.uhhospitals.org/about-uh/publications/uh-annual-report/2022-annual-report
notes: Ohio Major Employers report (Dec. 2022) lists University Hospitals Health System at 30,891 Ohio employees, headquartered in Shaker Heights; UH's 2021 annual report says more than 30,000 employees. Form 5500 shows 34,924 participants in 2023. Nonprofit 501(c)(3) health system; no JobsOhio metrics row matched.

name: CASE WESTERN RESERVE UNIVERSITY
emp_source: https://www.univstats.com/staffs/case-western-reserve-university/; https://case.edu/ir/cwru-facts/faculty-and-staff-facts
notes: IPEDS-derived counts show about 1,485 faculty and 4,766 non-instructional staff (about 6,250 total) in 2023; Form 5500 shows 5,852 participants in 2023, consistent with 5,000+. Private nonprofit university in Cleveland, founded there (Western Reserve College 1826, Case School 1880). Grants likely tied to the Cleveland Innovation District.

name: CLEVELAND STATE UNIVERSITY
parent: Cleveland State University (State of Ohio public university)
emp_source: https://www.univstats.com/salary/cleveland-state-university/; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cleveland_State_University
notes: IPEDS-derived counts show roughly 1,200 faculty and 1,000 administrative staff (about 2,300 total; a narrower count gives 1,369). Public university established in Cleveland in 1964. Grants likely tied to the Cleveland Innovation District; no JobsOhio metrics row matched.

name: SEEFRIED DEVELOPMENT SERVICES INC
emp_source: https://www.linkedin.com/company/seefried-industrial-properties-inc-; https://www.crainscleveland.com/article/20170720/news/170729980/amazon-may-stake-claim-old-randall-park-mall-site
notes: Seefried is a privately held Atlanta industrial developer (founded 1984) with a few dozen employees (about 36 per directory data); it built and leased Amazon fulfillment centers in Ohio at North Randall (former Randall Park Mall, opened 2018) and Euclid, with JobsOhio revitalization money. The $14M in FY2018-2020 is a pass-through for Amazon-tenanted buildings, so the real beneficiary is Amazon (Seattle, WA, 5000+), not a small business.

name: IRONUNITS LLC
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Revitalization Grant; Workforce Grant
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000764065/000076406520000041/clf-2019123110xk.htm; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/764065/000076406521000084/clf-20201231.htm
notes: IronUnits LLC is the Cleveland-Cliffs subsidiary that owns the Toledo HBI plant (130 permanent jobs). Cliffs' FY2019 10-K reports 2,372 employees at Dec. 31, 2019 (500-4999 for the FY2019 grant), then about 25,000 after the AK Steel and ArcelorMittal USA acquisitions in 2020, so the FY2020 and FY2022 grants fall in 5000+. Cleveland-based since 1847.

name: CINCINNATI CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL MEDICAL CENTER
emp_source: https://dam.assets.ohio.gov/image/upload/development.ohio.gov/research/obs/Ohio-Major-Employers-Report.pdf; https://www.cincinnatichildrens.org/about/corporate/facts-figures
notes: Ohio Major Employers report (Dec. 2022) lists Cincinnati Children's at 17,204 Ohio employees; Form 5500 shows 20,344 participants in 2019 and 27,933 in 2023. Nonprofit 501(c)(3) pediatric system founded in Cincinnati in 1883. JobsOhio metrics classify the $32M commitment as 'Other Loan'.

name: FirstEnergy Generation LLC
metrics_programs: Revitalization Grant; Revitalization Grant Phase II
emp_source: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/fe/employees/; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1031296/000103129618000015/fe-12312017x10k.htm
notes: FirstEnergy Generation LLC was a wholly owned subsidiary of FirstEnergy Solutions, itself a subsidiary of Akron-based FirstEnergy Corp. (about 15,600 employees at end of 2017 per the 10-K). The $12.4M is the JobsOhio revitalization loan for cleanup of the retired R.E. Burger coal plant site in Belmont County, later forgiven and reported by Ohio Capital Journal; FES entered bankruptcy in 2018 and became Energy Harbor in 2020.

name: PTTGC AMERICA LLC
parent: PTT Global Chemical Public Company Limited (PTTGC), majority-owned by PTT Plc
emp_source: https://www.zoominfo.com/c/ptt-global-chemical-public-company-ltd/347530219; https://www.theintelligencer.net/news/top-headlines/2022/03/ptt-global-pays-jobsohio-20m-for-failing-to-move-on-belmont-county-cracker-plant/
notes: PTTGC America is the US arm of Bangkok-listed PTT Global Chemical (5,000-10,000 employees per directory data; PTT Plc, the Thai state oil company, holds the controlling stake). Partner Daelim (South Korea) withdrew in 2020. JobsOhio grants funded Belmont County cracker-site work; PTTGC repaid $20M in 2022 after failing to reach a final investment decision.

name: HONDA DEVELOPMENT & MANUFACTURING OF AMERICA LLC
metrics_company: Honda Development & Manufacturing of America, LLC
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Research & Development Grant
emp_source: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/hmc/employees/; https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/honda-motor-co-ltd-files-annual-report-on-form-20-f-for-fiscal-year-ended-march-31-2024-302177986.html
notes: Honda Development & Manufacturing of America LLC (Marysville, OH; the 990 lists 'PA' in error) was formed April 1, 2021 by merging Honda's US manufacturing companies; its parent is Tokyo-based Honda Motor Co., about 194,993 consolidated employees at March 31, 2024 per the Form 20-F. Form 5500 for the EIN shows 41,442 participants under American Honda Motor Co. in 2023; JobsOhio metrics show 8,023 retained jobs and a $232M commitment tied to the EV hub.

name: Fuyao Glass America Inc
parent: Fuyao Glass Industry Group Co., Ltd.
emp_source: https://www.daytondailynews.com/news/breaking-news/fuyao-set-double-hiring-moraine-plant-500-jobs/XIW2hI9dJ3w0Rw5Uw8KVnL/; https://www.dnb.com/business-directory/company-profiles/fuyao-glass-industry-group-co-ltd.698fe3f436b3635a6dea9ede7d781e50
notes: Fuyao Glass America is the Moraine, OH subsidiary of Fuyao Glass Industry Group, Fuqing, Fujian, China (Shanghai/Hong Kong listed; about 18,000 employees worldwide per Dayton Daily News in 2016 and about 26,000 per D&B). The Moraine plant alone grew past 2,000 workers by 2017; Form 5500 participants rose from 233 in 2015 to 3,729 in 2019. JobsOhio grants: $5.6M for 800 jobs, $4M workforce, $6.6M for the 2016 expansion.

name: GENERAL ELECTRIC COMPANY
emp_source: https://www.ge.com/sites/default/files/ge_10k_02022024.pdf
notes: GE's FY2023 10-K reports about 125,000 employees at Dec. 31, 2023 (283,000 at end of 2018), headquartered in Boston, MA during FY2018-2023; after the April 2024 spin-offs GE Aerospace moved the HQ to Evendale, OH, so the FY2024 grant went to an Ohio-headquartered parent. The R&D grants go to GE Aviation/Aerospace in Evendale (6,450 retained jobs). GE was founded in New York in 1892.

name: PETMIN USA INC
emp_source: https://www.petmin.co.za/somkhele.php; https://www.miningreview.com/top-stories/petmin-announces-r350m-bbbee-deal-for-somkhele-anthracite-mine/
notes: Petmin USA is the subsidiary of Johannesburg-based Petmin, a private mining company (delisted from the JSE in 2017 after a private-equity-backed buyout) whose Somkhele anthracite mine employs roughly 1,000-1,600 people per company and trade-press sources. JobsOhio paid $5M economic development plus $5M revitalization for the $474M Ashtabula pig-iron plant, promised 110 jobs; the plant was still not built as of 2024, and no audited headcount for 2020 was found.

name: THE METROHEALTH SYSTEM
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MetroHealth
notes: Cuyahoga County's public hospital system, governed by a county-appointed board; almost 9,000 employees as of December 2023 and the 10th largest employer in Northeast Ohio. Not a business; grant was $10M in FY2022 and FY2024.

name: Cleveland 2016 Host Committee Inc
emp_source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/471304221
notes: Single-purpose 501(c)(3) that raised money for the 2016 Republican National Convention in Cleveland; revenue of $34.2M (2014), $7.4M (2015) and $16.3M (2016), then wound down to zero by 2018. Its 990s list a handful of officers (David Gilbert, Jon Pinney) and no large staff, so the bucket is a floor from the filings rather than a stated headcount.

name: TRANSPORTATION RESEARCH CENTER INC
parent: Transportation Research Center Inc. (affiliate of The Ohio State University)
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transportation_Research_Center
notes: TRC Inc. is a 501(c)(3) affiliated with Ohio State that operates the East Liberty proving grounds on Honda-owned land under a 1988 management agreement; Wikipedia says more than 400 employees, JobsOhio's own report shows 347 retained jobs, and its Form 5500 counted 454-471 participants in 2015-2023. Auto class said business; the grants were $9M of R&D money for the SMART Center, so a reader may ask whether this is really a university or Honda project.

name: THE RESEARCH INSTITUTE AT NATIONWIDE CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nationwide_Children%27s_Hospital
notes: The Research Institute is a 501(c)(3) arm of Nationwide Children's Hospital in Columbus, which reports about 11,900 employees. ProPublica lists the EIN under 'Nationwide Childrens Hospital Inc (Research Institute At Nationwide)'.

name: DIGITAL ACCESS OHIO LLC
parent: altafiber (Cincinnati Bell Inc.), owned by Macquarie Infrastructure Partners; Digital Access Ohio is its joint venture with JobsOhio
notes: Digital Access Ohio LLC was formed in 2022 by Canton-based Agile Networks with JobsOhio committing up to $40M; altafiber (Cincinnati Bell) bought Agile on May 2, 2022 for $65.5M, and its FY2022 10-K calls DAO 'our Joint Venture with the State of Ohio', carries the JobsOhio money as a 'Digital Access Ohio Advance' and reports about 5,800 employees at December 31, 2022. Cincinnati Bell itself has been owned by Macquarie's Red Fiber Parent LLC since September 2021, so JobsOhio's grants flowed into a JV it co-owns with a PE-held telecom, not a small business.

name: LAWRENCE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION
metrics_programs: Revitalization Grant; Revitalization Loan; Spec Development (OSIP)
emp_source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/311075744
notes: County economic development corporation and JobsOhio network partner (via OhioSE) in South Point; its 990s list three key staff (Bill Dingus, Jeremy Clay, Jesse Layne) and revenue of $3.6M-$14.3M a year in 2018-2024. Grants were revitalization and spec-building (OSIP) money for The Point industrial park, not an operating business.

name: COVERMYMEDS LLC
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/927653/000092765320000033/mck10k3312020.htm
notes: CoverMyMeds was founded in Twinsburg in 2008 and bought by McKesson in January 2017 for $1.1B (about 450 employees then), before the first grant year; McKesson's FY2020 10-K reports about 80,000 employees. McKesson moved its HQ from San Francisco, CA to Irving, TX effective April 1, 2019, so the FY2017 grant was under a CA parent and the 2019-2022 grants under a TX parent.

name: FIRST SOLAR INC
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Research & Development Grant; Workforce Grant
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1274494/000162828021003343/fslr-20201231.htm
notes: Public company (NASDAQ: FSLR) headquartered in Tempe, AZ; FY2020 10-K reports approximately 5,100 associates as of December 31, 2020. Its predecessor Solar Cells Inc. started in Toledo, but the parent was formed in Arizona in 1999 and the Ohio plants in Perrysburg and Lake Township are subsidiaries.

name: NESTLE PURINA PETCARE COMPANY
emp_source: https://www.jobsohio.com/newsroom/news-press/nestle-purina-petcare-will-build-a-new-factory-in-ohio-to-meet-growing-pet-food-demand
notes: Nestlé Purina PetCare (St. Louis, MO) is a wholly owned division of Nestlé S.A. of Vevey, Switzerland, which employs roughly 270,000-275,000 people; the JobsOhio release says Nestlé alone had 3,300 Ohio employees when it announced the $550M Williamsburg Township plant. The EDGAR match is the legacy Ralston Purina registrant, not a current filer.

name: JPMORGAN CHASE BANK NA
edgar_name: Warehouse Funding Avery Point VII, LLC
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961720000257/corp10k2019.htm
notes: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. (Columbus-chartered) is the main bank subsidiary of JPMorgan Chase & Co., New York; the FY2019 10-K reports headcount of 256,981 and JobsOhio's 2018 release puts its central Ohio workforce at 19,200. The EDGAR match to 'Warehouse Funding Avery Point VII' is a trust filing under the bank's EIN, not the parent.

name: BRITISH AIRWAYS PLC
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Airlines_Group
notes: British Airways has been a wholly owned subsidiary of IAG since 2011; IAG is registered in Madrid, Spain with corporate headquarters in London and about 76,000 employees. The FY2024 payment is an Air Service Restoration Program route incentive for the CVG-London Heathrow flight that began June 2023, not a site project.

name: YORKVILLE INTERMODAL TERMINALS LLC
metrics_programs: Revitalization Grant; Revitalization Grant Phase II
parent: Yorkville Intermodal Terminals LLC (Charles J. Betters and Victor DiGeronimo)
emp_source: https://www.timesleaderonline.com/news/local-news/2017/05/yorkville-officials-brainstorm-ideas-to-create-growth/
notes: Project LLC formed December 2016 (Ohio charter 3965739) by Aliquippa, PA developer Charles J. Betters (C.J. Betters Enterprises) with Cleveland's Victor DiGeronimo (Independence Excavating) to buy and clean up the former Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel mill in Yorkville for a barge terminal; a 2024 Jefferson County Port Authority report still calls it an ownership group marketing the site. The LLC itself has no staff; the owners' companies are private and no source gives their size, so the bucket reflects the LLC only.

name: GREAT LAKES CHEESE CO INC
emp_source: https://www.geaugamapleleaf.com/news/john-epprecht-describes-huge-expansion-of-glc-operation/
notes: Privately held, Epprecht family-controlled cheese packer headquartered in Hiram with employees holding a 20% ESOP stake; a February 2020 presentation put the Hiram plant at more than 500 workers and the new headquarters at 253, its Form 5500 counted 3,507 participants in 2019 (4,879 by 2023), and JobsOhio shows 671 retained jobs on the $5.1M grant. Company-wide it sat under 5,000 in 2020-2021 but is close to that line now.

name: Honda of America Mfg Inc
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Honda
notes: Honda of America Mfg., Inc. (Marysville, Anna and East Liberty plants) was the U.S. manufacturing subsidiary of Tokyo-based Honda Motor Co., which employed roughly 200,000 people worldwide in 2015-2016 (194,173 in 2025); JobsOhio shows 2,520 retained jobs on the Anna engine plant project. In 2020 the entity was folded into Honda Development & Manufacturing of America, LLC.

name: JEFFERIS REAL ESTATE LLC
parent: Jefferis Real Estate, LLC (T.J. and John Jefferis Sr.)
emp_source: https://www.daily-jeff.com/story/news/2018/05/09/barnesville-firm-honored-by-development/12214242007/
notes: Family real-estate developer founded in Barnesville in 2001 by brothers T.J. and John Jefferis Sr.; by 2018 it had built nine leased industrial buildings in Barnesville-area industrial parks, mostly for oil and gas tenants employing over 400 people, and JobsOhio's June 2018 report shows a $5M Revitalization Grant against $6.4M of investment and zero direct jobs. No headcount is published; a two-owner developer of this kind is very likely under 100 employees, and the 400 jobs belong to tenants, not to Jefferis.

name: MIDMARK CORPORATION
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Research & Development Grant
emp_source: https://www.jobsohio.com/newsroom/news-press/midmark-expands-its-healthcare-manufacturing-footprint-in-ohio
notes: Private, family-controlled medical and dental equipment maker founded in Versailles in 1915 with corporate offices in Miamisburg (Dayton area); the JobsOhio release on the Versailles expansion cites nearly 2,000 employees worldwide, 1,002 retained and 99 new jobs, and its Form 5500 shows 1,678 participants in 2019.

name: ANDELYN BIOSCIENCES INC
metrics_programs: Growth Fund Loan; Research & Development Grant
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nationwide_Children%27s_Hospital
notes: Andelyn is a for-profit gene-therapy contract manufacturer spun out of Nationwide Children's clinical manufacturing group in 2020 and wholly owned by the hospital, which has about 11,900 employees; Andelyn itself committed 170 jobs and JobsOhio gave a $5M R&D Center Grant plus a Growth Fund loan for its 185,000 sq ft Columbus plant. On its own Andelyn would be 100-499; the bucket follows the ultimate parent rule.

name: ENSEMBLE HP
parent: Ensemble Health Partners (majority owned by Golden Gate Capital from August 2019; founded by Bon Secours Mercy Health)
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1865597/000119312521286798/d132904ds1.htm
notes: Cincinnati (Blue Ash) hospital revenue-cycle firm founded 2014 by Mercy Health; Golden Gate Capital took a majority stake on August 1, 2019 and the September 2021 S-1 reports 6,492 full-time employees as of June 30, 2021 with principal offices at 11511 Reed Hartman Highway, Cincinnati. At the first grant year it was smaller (3,600 employees in May 2019 per the Golden Gate deal coverage), so the bucket reflects the later grant years; the IPO was pulled and Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners bought in during 2022.

name: Ohio-West Virginia Excavating Co
metrics_programs: Revitalization Grant; Revitalization Grant Phase II
parent: Ohio-West Virginia Excavating Co. (Dennis Hendershot and Roger Lewis)
emp_source: https://www.timesleaderonline.com/news/local-news/2022/02/shadyside-approves-ohio-business-for-water-project/
notes: Shadyside excavating contractor run by Dennis Hendershot and Roger Lewis that owned the largest tract of the 500-acre Dilles Bottom site beside FirstEnergy's Burger plant, which JobsOhio's 2015 Revitalization Grants ($3M plus $277,275) helped prepare for PTT Global Chemical's proposed ethane cracker; the cracker was never built. No source gives a headcount; it bids roughly $1M municipal jobs, so 100-499 is a guess between a small local contractor and a mid-size one, and the grant really paid for site work, hence site_development.

name: HONDA DEVELOPMENT & MANUFACTURING OF AMERICA LLC
metrics_company: Honda Development & Manufacturing of America, LLC
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Research & Development Grant
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Honda
notes: Honda Development & Manufacturing of America, LLC (Raymond/Marysville) is the 2020 merger of Honda's North American manufacturing and R&D subsidiaries, wholly owned by Tokyo-based Honda Motor Co. with roughly 200,000 employees worldwide; JobsOhio shows 8,023 retained jobs and $232M of total commitments, most of it the 2022 EV and battery package. The EIN predates the LLC (it was Honda R&D Americas' EIN), which is why grants appear under it in 2019.

name: FCA US LLC
parent: Fiat Chrysler Automobiles N.V. (Stellantis N.V. from Jan 2021)
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1605484/000160548420000011/fca20191231annualreportand.htm
notes: FCA N.V. 20-F for 2019 reports 191,752 employees, incorporated in the Netherlands with principal executive offices in London. FCA US LLC (Toledo Jeep plants) became a Stellantis N.V. (Netherlands) subsidiary on Jan 16, 2021, which covers the FY2021 grant.

name: PORT OF GREATER CINCINNATI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
metrics_company: Port of Greater Cincinnati Development Authority
metrics_programs: Revitalization Grant; Revitalization Grant Phase II; Spec Development (OSIP)
parent: Port of Greater Cincinnati Development Authority
emp_source: https://www.cincinnatiport.org/wp-content/uploads/Port_of_Greater_Cincinnati_Dev_Authority_2024-Hamilton_FINAL-1.pdf
notes: Public port authority created by the City of Cincinnati and Hamilton County; grants were Revitalization and OSIP spec-development money passed through to sites. Staff is a few dozen per its website and audited financial report; no exact headcount was published.

name: JSW STEEL USA OHIO INC
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JSW_Steel
notes: JSW Steel USA Ohio is the former Acero Junction mill in Mingo Junction, bought in 2018 by JSW Steel Ltd of Mumbai (JSW Group), which reported well over 10,000 employees through the grant years. Form 5500 shows 333 to 345 participants at the Ohio entity alone; JobsOhio counted 400 retained jobs.

name: NORTH STAR BLUESCOPE STEEL LLC
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BlueScope
notes: North Star BlueScope Steel in Delta became wholly owned by Melbourne-based BlueScope Steel after it bought Cargill's 50 percent in 2015; BlueScope reported roughly 14,000 employees in FY2020 and 16,500 in 2024. Form 5500 shows 477 to 656 participants at the Delta mill alone.

name: SILFEX INC
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/707549/000070754919000124/lrcx10k2019document.htm
notes: Silfex is a wholly owned subsidiary of Lam Research (Fremont, CA), whose FY2019 10-K reports approximately 10,700 regular employees. Silfex has operated in Eaton since 1971 and expanded into Springfield, but the parent is Californian.

name: NOVAGARD SOLUTIONS INC
emp_source: https://www.jobsohio.com/annual-report-2021/economy-results/innovation
notes: Privately held, woman-owned silicone maker with a single 200,000 sq ft Cleveland site; JobsOhio counted 113 retained jobs and 50 new jobs tied to the R&D Center Grant, and the company cites 45 percent workforce growth from 2018 to 2022. No exact total headcount was published, but one site with roughly 113 to 170 jobs puts it in 100-499.

name: ZANESVILLE MUSKINGUM COUNTY PORT AUTHORITY
emp_source: https://www.chmura.com/blog/how-zanesville-muskingum-county-used-jobseq-to-win-3.1-million-state-grant
notes: County economic development port authority that received a $3.09 million JobsOhio spec-development (OSIP) grant to buy and prepare the National Road Business Park site. It is a small public agency with a handful of staff; no headcount is published.

name: LIBBEY GLASS
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/902274/000143774920003729/lby20191231_10k.htm
notes: Libbey's last 10-K (2019) reports 5,872 employees, about 70 percent outside the US; the company went through Chapter 11 in 2020 and emerged privately held by its former lenders as Libbey Glass LLC, still headquartered in Toledo. Founded in 1818 in Massachusetts and moved to Toledo in 1888; Form 5500 shows 2,349 US participants in 2023, so post-bankruptcy worldwide headcount near 5,000 is an estimate.

name: GOJO INDUSTRIES INC
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Growth Fund Loan
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GOJO_Industries
notes: Family-owned Purell maker founded in Akron in 1946 and headquartered there; Wooster is a plant. Roughly 2,500 employees, consistent with Form 5500 participant counts of 2,086 (2019) and 2,373 (2023); Clorox agreed to buy GOJO in January 2026, after the grant years.

name: PRATT PAPER (OH) LLC
parent: Pratt Industries, Inc. (Anthony Pratt / Visy group)
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Visy_Industries
notes: Pratt Paper (OH) LLC is the Wapakoneta recycled-paper mill of Pratt Industries, the Conyers, Georgia US arm of Anthony Pratt's privately held Visy group of Melbourne, Australia; the combined group reported about 11,000 employees in 2020. Pratt Industries alone does not publish a headcount, but with six mills and dozens of plants it is well above 5,000.

name: PAYCOR INC
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1839439/000183943921000011/pycr-20210630.htm
notes: Paycor's first 10-K (FY ended June 30, 2021) reports 2,067 associates and Cincinnati headquarters; Form 5500 shows 2,069 participants in 2019. During the FY2020 grant Paycor was majority owned by private equity firm Apax Partners (acquired Nov 2018), and it went public in July 2021.

name: BREEZE AVIATION GROUP
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breeze_Airways
notes: Breeze Airways, founded by David Neeleman in 2018 and based in Cottonwood Heights, Utah, began flying in May 2021; Form 5500 shows 1,025 plan participants in 2023 and the airline reports about 2,262 employees in 2026. The grants are JobsOhio Air Service Restoration payments for routes at Akron-Canton, not a plant or office project.

name: AMERICAN NITRILE OPERATIONS LLC
emp_source: https://abc6onyourside.com/news/local/american-nitrile-plant-ppe-factory-produce-medical-gloves-bring-hundreds-of-jobs-to-grove-city-central-ohio-founder-jacob-block-3-9-2022
notes: Privately held glove startup founded in Grove City in 2021 by Jacob Block, financed with $105 million from Orion Infrastructure Capital, and the first pre-revenue company to get a JobsOhio grant ($3.5 million committed). It planned 400 jobs, but Form 5500 shows only 33 plan participants in 2023, so actual headcount in the grant years may have been under 100.

name: NESTLE USA INC
f5500_sponsor: NESTLE USA, INC. SAVINGS PLAN ADMINISTRATION
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nestl%C3%A9
notes: Nestle USA (Solon R&D and headquarters functions) is a subsidiary of Nestlé S.A. of Vevey, Switzerland, which reported 291,000 employees in 2019 and 276,000 in 2021. Form 5500 shows over 44,000 US plan participants.

name: SEEFRIED DEVELOPMENT MANAGEMENT INC
emp_source: https://www.linkedin.com/company/seefried-industrial-properties-inc-
notes: Seefried is a privately held Atlanta industrial developer (founded 1984 by Ferdinand Seefried) with roughly 58 employees per LinkedIn; it built Amazon's Ohio fulfillment centers, including the Akron Rolling Acres site named in JobsOhio's 2019 release. The FY2021 grant is site money for an Amazon building, so the beneficiary tenant was Amazon, not a small company.

name: CITY OF SPRINGFIELD OHIO
metrics_programs: Aerospace and Defense Opportunity Grant; Spec Development (OSIP)
emp_source: https://www.jobsohio.com/industries/advanced-aerospace-defense/advanced-air-mobility
notes: Municipal government; grants were an Aerospace and Defense Opportunity Grant and OSIP money for the National Advanced Air Mobility Center of Excellence and related infrastructure at Springfield-Beckley Municipal Airport. City workforce is in the several hundreds, but no published headcount was found on the city site or in JobsOhio materials.

name: ALTIVIA PETROCHEMICALS LLC
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Revitalization Grant; Workforce Grant
emp_source: https://www.linkedin.com/company/altivia-corporation
notes: Altivia Petrochemicals is a unit of privately owned ALTIVIA of Houston (founded 1986), which bought the Haverhill phenol plant in 2015; JobsOhio counted 137 retained jobs there and LinkedIn lists about 220 employees company-wide. Form 5500 shows 418 participants at the petrochemicals unit in 2023, so total headcount across ALTIVIA's seven units could be near 500.

name: TOTAL QUALITY LOGISTICS LLC
emp_source: https://www.jobsohio.com/newsroom/ohio-success/total-quality-logistics-continues-to-invest-millions-in-ohio
notes: Privately held freight brokerage founded in Cincinnati in 1997 by Ken Oaks and headquartered in Union Township, Clermont County; JobsOhio's 2022 release puts headcount over 9,000 after 49 percent growth in 2021, implying roughly 6,000 in 2020. JobsOhio counted 2,623 retained Ohio jobs.

name: MEDPACE INC
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1668397/000156459020006385/medp-10k_20191231.htm
notes: Medpace's 2019 10-K reports approximately 3,500 employees worldwide and Cincinnati headquarters; founded there in 1992 by August Troendle. Form 5500 shows 2,189 participants in 2019 and 3,462 in 2023, and JobsOhio counted 1,916 retained Ohio jobs.

name: DANA LIMITED
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Research & Development Grant
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/26780/000002678019000004/dan-20181231x10k.htm
notes: Dana Limited is a subsidiary of Dana Incorporated (NYSE: DAN), headquartered in Maumee, whose 2018 10-K reports approximately 30,900 employees. The 10-K traces the business to 1904 but does not name the founding city.

name: NSG GLASS NORTH AMERICA INC
parent: Nippon Sheet Glass Co., Ltd. (NSG Group)
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nippon_Sheet_Glass
notes: NSG Glass North America Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary that built the Luckey/Troy Township float and TCO glass plant (announced Oct 2018, opened Nov 2020, 125-150 jobs) to supply First Solar. Parent NSG Group is Tokyo-based with 25,356 employees as of March 2024 (higher, around 27,000, in the 2019-2021 grant years); it acquired Ohio-rooted Pilkington North America in 2006.

name: PRO-TEC COATING COMPANY LLC
parent: United States Steel Corp. and Kobe Steel Ltd. (50/50 joint venture)
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/U.S._Steel
notes: PRO-TEC is a 50/50 JV of U.S. Steel (Pittsburgh, PA) and Kobe Steel (Kobe, Japan) per U.S. Steel's SEC exhibit on the $400M Leipsic galvanizing line that started up in 2019; neither partner alone controls, so PA is the U.S. partner's HQ and Japan is the other half. Both parents have tens of thousands of employees (U.S. Steel about 22,000-28,000; Kobe Steel about 38,000); the JV itself reported 397 Form 5500 participants in 2019 and 310 retained jobs.

name: ADAMS COUNTY CIC
emp_source: https://www.adamscountyohecd.com/adams-county-community-improvement-corporation-cic-receives-4-2-million-jobsohio-grant-to-develop-the-winchester-industrial-park-and-attract-new-business/
notes: County community improvement corporation (a nonprofit economic development corporation under Ohio law) that received a $4.2M JobsOhio site grant through the JobsOhio-Ohio Southeast Site Initiative/OSIP to build water, sewer and a road for the Winchester Industrial Park. Staffed by the county's economic development office, so headcount is a handful; no employee figure is published.

name: QUALITY ELECTRODYNAMICS LLC
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canon_Inc.
notes: Canon Inc. (Tokyo, about 184,000 employees in 2021) bought 70% of QED on Oct 31, 2019 and consolidates it, covering the 2021 and 2022 grants; the 2018 grant predates the sale, when QED was founder-owned with about 175 employees. QED itself was founded in Mayfield Village in 2006 by Hiroyuki Fujita, who kept the remaining 30%.

name: PELLA CORPORATION
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pella_Corporation
notes: Privately held window and door maker founded 1925 in Pella, Iowa, with about 7,000 employees (2019) to 10,000 nationwide; its own Form 5500 plan shows 8,521 participants in 2019 and 11,593 in 2023, consistent with 5000+. The grant supported a new Troy, Ohio manufacturing plant.

name: AMAZONCOM SERVICES LLC
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872423000004/amzn-20221231.htm
notes: Amazon.com Services LLC is the operating subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc. (Seattle), which reported about 1,541,000 full- and part-time employees at Dec 31, 2022 in its 10-K. The Form 5500 plan under this EIN had 1,295,394 participants in 2023.

name: HYLAND SOFTWARE INC
parent: Hyland Software, Inc. (majority owned by Thoma Bravo)
emp_source: https://topworkplaces.com/company/hyland-software-inc/
notes: Founded 1991 and headquartered in Westlake; private equity firm Thoma Bravo has been majority owner since 2007. Form 5500 participants were 3,242 in 2019 and Top Workplaces lists about 3,500 US employees, so the company was under 5,000 in the 2018-2020 grant years (it reached roughly 5,000 by 2023, when it cut 1,000 jobs).

name: ABBOTT LABORATORIES
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1800/000162828024005348/abt-20231231.htm
notes: Public company headquartered in Abbott Park, Illinois; its FY2023 10-K reports approximately 114,000 employees, 69% outside the U.S. The Ohio grants relate to the Columbus nutrition plant (428 retained jobs per JobsOhio metrics).

name: SOFIDEL AMERICA CORP
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Growth Fund Loan; Workforce Grant
parent: Sofidel S.p.A. (Sofidel Group; Stefani and Lazzareschi families)
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sofidel_Group
notes: Sofidel America Corp. is the U.S. arm of the family-owned Sofidel Group of Porcari, Italy, which had more than 6,400 employees around 2019 (6,900 by 2023); the Circleville tissue plant opened Oct 2018 as the group's largest. The U.S. entity's own Form 5500 plan grew from 347 participants (2015) to 1,244 (2019).

name: AMG VANADIUM LLC
emp_source: https://www.globenewswire.com/en/news-release/2021/03/11/2191615/0/en/AMG-Advanced-Metallurgical-Group-N-V-Publishes-2020-Annual-Report.html
notes: AMG Vanadium LLC (Cambridge, OH, about 155 employees) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Amsterdam-listed AMG Advanced Metallurgical Group N.V., whose 2020 annual report states approximately 3,000 employees worldwide. The grant supported the $300M second plant in Zanesville.

name: WESTERN RESERVE PORT AUTHORITY
metrics_programs: Aerospace and Defense Opportunity Grant; Revitalization Grant Phase II; Spec Development (OSIP)
emp_source: https://codes.ohio.gov/ohio-revised-code/chapter-4582
notes: Port authority created under Ohio Revised Code Chapter 4582 with board members appointed by the Mahoning and Trumbull county commissioners; it owns the Youngstown-Warren Regional Airport and received OSIP spec-building and aerospace grants. A political subdivision with a small staff; no employee count published.

name: SAREPTA THERAPEUTICS
emp_source: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/srpt/employees/
notes: Public biotech headquartered in Cambridge, MA (FY2022 10-K); 10-K-derived headcounts were 840 (2021), 1,162 (2022) and 1,314 (2023), with 575 Form 5500 participants in 2019 and 1,415 in 2023. The grants supported its Columbus gene therapy facilities (138 retained jobs).

name: ATHENS COUNTY PORT AUTHORITY
emp_source: https://codes.ohio.gov/ohio-revised-code/chapter-4582
notes: County port authority, a political subdivision organized under Ohio Revised Code Chapter 4582, used as the public vehicle for JobsOhio site grants in Athens County. No project release or staffing figure was found online (searched OhioSE, JobsOhio and Athens news sites); a small-staff public body regardless.

name: CARESOURCE MANAGEMENT SERVICES LLC
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CareSource
notes: CareSource Management Services LLC is the management subsidiary of CareSource, a Dayton nonprofit Medicaid/Medicare health plan founded in 1989 with about 4,500 employees and $11.8B revenue in 2020 (Form 5500 sponsor CareSource Management Group had 4,622 participants in 2019). Classed nonprofit rather than hospital because it is an insurer, not a health system.

name: THE BABCOCK & WILCOX COMPANY
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1630805/000163080521000004/bw-20201231.htm
notes: NYSE-listed B&W moved its headquarters from Charlotte to Akron on Dec 30, 2019 (the Charlotte address in the 990 is the old one), and its FY2020 10-K reports approximately 2,100 employees worldwide. Form 5500 participants (7,259 in 2019) run far above headcount because they include retirees and former employees of the much larger pre-2015 company.

name: JAC PRODUCTS INC
emp_source: https://archive.businessviewmagazine.com/jac-products-inc/
notes: Private automotive roof-rack maker headquartered in Saline, Michigan (technical center in Pontiac) with about 1,500 North American employees in 2015 and 1,910 Form 5500 participants in 2019; the Ohio project is a Napoleon, OH plant. Ownership has been reported as venture/private capital in the past, but no current owner filing was found.

name: CROWN EQUIPMENT CORPORATION
emp_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crown_Equipment_Corporation
notes: Family-owned lift truck maker founded 1945 in New Bremen, Ohio, with about 20,900 employees worldwide today and 11,737 Form 5500 participants in 2019; JobsOhio counts 4,348 retained Ohio jobs. Fourth generation of the Dicke family still leads it.

name: XELLIA PHARMACEUTICALS USA LLC
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Revitalization Grant; Workforce Grant
parent: Xellia Pharmaceuticals ApS (wholly owned by Novo Holdings A/S)
emp_source: https://www.biospace.com/xellia-pharmaceuticals-cleveland-ohio-manufacturing-facility-commercially-operational-for-production-of-key-anti-infective-drug-products-for-us-hospitals-and-patients
notes: Copenhagen-based anti-infectives maker with over 1,800 employees globally (2021) and more than 300 at the Bedford, Ohio plant it bought from Boehringer Ingelheim in 2015; wholly owned since 2013 by Novo Holdings A/S, the Novo Nordisk Foundation's investment arm. Form 5500 participants at the U.S. entity were 419 in 2019.

name: CALDWELL MOBILE HOME SALES INC
parent: Caldwell Mobile Home Sales, Inc. / Crock Construction (family-owned)
emp_source: https://www.jobsohio.com/newsroom/news-press/new-business-park-in-noble-county-announces-4-8-million-investment
notes: Landowner and developer of the Caldwell East of I-77 Business Park in Noble County, funded with over $2.4M in JobsOhio-Ohio Southeast Site Initiative grants (April 2022 release), described as a third-generation family-owned local construction and manufactured-home retail company. No employee count, Form 5500 or directory listing was found; a rural family retailer with no pension filing is almost certainly under 100.

name: VOSS INDUSTRIES LLC
f5500_sponsor: VOSS INDUSTRIES, INC. EMPLOYEE STOCK OWNERSHIP PLAN AND TRUST
metrics_programs: Economic Development Grant; Revitalization Grant; Revitalization Grant Phase II; Workforce Grant
parent: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. (via Consolidated Aerospace Manufacturing; CAM was Tinicum-owned until Feb 2020)
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/93556/000009355621000008/swk-20210102.htm
notes: Voss was bought from its ESOP in Sept 2014 by Consolidated Aerospace Manufacturing (CAM), a Tinicum private equity portfolio company, which Stanley Black & Decker (New Britain, CT; about 53,100 employees) acquired for $1.46B on Feb 24, 2020, inside the FY2020 grant year. During the FY2019 grant the owner was PE-backed CAM, whose group headcount was not published; Voss alone had 170-291 Form 5500 participants.

name: TOPRE AMERICA CORPORATION
emp_source: https://www.topre.co.jp/en/company/profile.html; https://www.jobsohio.com/newsroom/news-press/automotive-supplier-topre-goes-big-on-second-expansion
notes: Topre America is the Springfield subsidiary of Tokyo-listed Topre Corporation; the company profile lists 6,860 consolidated employees as of March 2026, and the Springfield plant alone had 920 Form 5500 participants in 2019 and 580 retained jobs. A grant-year (2018-2022) consolidated figure was not fetched, so the 5000+ bucket rests on the 2026 count.

name: LOC PERFORMANCE PRODUCTS LLC
emp_source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/loc-performance-adds-capacity-for-trackman-in-st-marys-facility-301764105.html; https://www.jobsohio.com/newsroom/news-press/defense-contractor-loc-performance-products-to-create-250-new-jobs-in-auglaize-county
notes: Plymouth, Michigan defense and ag-track maker with more than 980 employees (Feb 2023 release) that bought Continental's St. Marys plant in Dec 2021 and committed 250 new jobs plus 450 retained. The EIN maps to CP Prime Holdings, L.P., a Form D filer c/o The Carlyle Group (sec.gov CIK 1837752), so the operating company is treated as the parent with Carlyle as private-equity owner.

name: ProMedica Health System Inc
emp_source: Form 5500 participants 19,307 (2019) for EIN 341517671; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ProMedica
notes: Toledo-based nonprofit health system founded 1986; its own retirement plan had 16,527 participants in 2015 and 19,307 in 2019, and the 2018 HCR ManorCare acquisition pushed total headcount well above that. Grant was a Revitalization Grant and Loan for the downtown Toledo headquarters project (900 jobs retained).

name: NANOGATE NORTH AMERICA
emp_source: https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nanogate
notes: Nanogate North America (Nanogate Jay Systems, the former Jay Plastics of Mansfield) was the US arm of Nanogate SE of Goettelborn, Germany, which had 1,209 employees in 2017 and about 400 in Mansfield; the $2 million JobsOhio grant funded a Mansfield R&D center announced April 2018. Nanogate SE filed for insolvency in June 2020 and its core business went to Techniplas in 2021, so ownership changed right at the end of the grant years.

name: UPTOWN SEQ HOLDINGS LLC
emp_source: https://terrexllc.com/about/
notes: SEQ matches the southeast quadrant of MLK Drive and Reading Road in Cincinnati, the 5.8-acre Uptown Gateway site developed by Cincinnati-based Terrex (founded 2014) with Messer Construction; the asterisk in JobsOhio's metrics marks it as a project entity. No source was found that names Uptown SEQ Holdings LLC's owner directly, and Terrex publishes no headcount, so parent and size are inferred.

name: SWAGELOK MANUFACTURING COMPANY LLC
emp_source: Form 5500 participants 5,777 (2019) for sponsor Swagelok Company; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swagelok
notes: Swagelok Manufacturing Company LLC is a unit of privately held Swagelok Company of Solon, founded in Cleveland in 1947, with over 5,700 associates; JobsOhio's own report shows 5,237 jobs retained on this grant. The company is private, so no SEC figure exists.

name: 3251 WESTERVILLE RD LLC
emp_source: https://www.financefund.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Connect-Housing-Blocks.pdf
notes: Address-named LLC for the former 500,000 sq ft retail site at 3251 Westerville Road, converted into a modular-home factory by Connect Housing Blocks, a subsidiary of Columbus developer Connect Realty (founder Brad DeHays), with a 300-job target. The factory was a startup at the 2023 grant, so the <100 bucket reflects the developer, not the planned jobs.

name: PLASTILENE INC
emp_source: https://www.wosu.org/2023-06-08/major-food-packaging-company-opens-first-location-washington-court-house-ohio
notes: Plastilene Inc. is the first US operation of Bogota-based Grupo Plastilene, which runs plants in Colombia, Ecuador and Guatemala and committed 58 R&D jobs and about $41-48 million in Washington Court House. No source giving the group's worldwide headcount was found (company site, JobsOhio release, WOSU and Dayton Development Coalition checked), so the bucket is a guess for a multi-country packaging manufacturer.

name: PROJECT BORON LLC
parent: Orlando Baking Company (with developer Weston Inc.)
emp_source: https://thelandcle.org/stories/despite-empty-land-companies-see-improvements-along-opportunity-corridor-with-promises-of-more-to-come/
notes: Project Boron is the 156,000 sq ft Cleveland Cold Storage building on Broadway Avenue, built by Cleveland industrial developer Weston Inc. for family-owned Orlando Baking (about 330 employees in 2023) with a $2 million JobsOhio Ohio Site Inventory Program grant. The city's community benefits page lists the entity as Boron Orlando Baking Co., LLC - Weston, Inc., so Weston co-owns the vehicle.

name: UNION HOME MORTGAGE CORP
emp_source: https://northeastohioregion.com/news/union-home-mortgage-to-expand/; Form 5500 participants 1,590 (2023)
notes: Privately held Strongsville mortgage lender with 1,300+ employees in July 2020 and 1,590 plan participants in 2023; the Revitalization Grant supported reuse of a vacant Strongsville building as its headquarters with 450 new jobs promised. Company materials describe it as Strongsville-based but the fetched sources do not state where it was founded.

name: URBAN RENEWABLES II LLC
emp_source: https://www.verdantas.com/about
notes: Urban Renewables II LLC is the brownfield redevelopment vehicle for the former Caraustar paperboard site in Rittman, taken over in 2012 by Ohio environmental firm Hull & Associates and its subsidiary, with John Hull listed as contact; Hull later merged into Verdantas (2,800 staff today). No grant-year headcount for Hull & Associates was found, so the bucket is a guess for a mid-size regional consultancy.

name: SFG COLUMBUS PARSONS LLC
emp_source: https://stonemontfinancial.com/team/
notes: SFG Columbus Parsons LLC is the Stonemont subsidiary building the three-building, 859,240 sq ft speculative Castings Commerce Park on the former Buckeye Steel/Columbus Castings site at 2211 Parsons Avenue; Stonemont is an Atlanta industrial developer whose team page lists 96 people. The headcount is a 2026 website roster, not a 2023 figure.

name: UGN INC
parent: UGN, Inc. (joint venture of Autoneum Holding AG and Nihon Tokushu Toryo)
emp_source: Form 5500 participants 1,886 (2019) for sponsor UGN, Inc.; https://ugn.com/about/
notes: UGN is a Tinley Park, Illinois acoustic-parts maker formed in 1986 as a partnership of Nittoku (Japan) and what is now Autoneum (Switzerland); neither partner is treated as sole parent, and Autoneum alone has about 16,000 employees. Grants supported the Monroe, Ohio plant (opened 2015, 111-job expansion 2018).

name: STERIS CORPORATION
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001757898&type=10-K; Form 5500 participants 8,647 (2019)
notes: Steris Corporation of Mentor is the US operating subsidiary of SEC registrant STERIS plc, which reported roughly 12,000-13,000 employees in its FY2016-FY2020 10-Ks; the parent was UK-domiciled from 2015 and Ireland-domiciled from 2019 after tax inversions, while executive operations stayed in Mentor. Founded in Ohio in 1985, so a reader may fairly call this an Ohio company with a foreign legal address.

name: SOUTHGATE COMPANY LIMITED PARTNERSHIP
emp_source: https://www.southgatecorporation.com/
notes: Southgate Company LP is a partnership of Southgate Corporation, a Newark, Ohio industrial-park developer founded 1953, which received an OSIP grant for an 84,000 sq ft speculative building at 33 Innovation Park in Marysville (Nov 2020). The company publishes no headcount; the <100 bucket is a guess for a regional developer.

name: ALKERMES INC
emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001520262&type=10-K; Form 5500 participants 2,336 (2019)
notes: Alkermes Inc. (Wilmington plant) is the US subsidiary of Dublin-based SEC registrant Alkermes plc, whose 10-Ks report about 2,000-2,300 employees across 2017-2021; the EDGAR HQ state MA reflects the Waltham US base. Founded 1987 in Massachusetts.

name: COTSWORKS LLC
emp_source: Form 5500 participants 105 (2019) and 108 (2023) for sponsor COTSWORKS, Inc.
notes: Highland Heights fiber-optic maker, an EDGAR Form D filer, with 105-108 plan participants and 73 jobs retained, so it sits at the line between <100 and 100-499. The company was acquired by Moog Inc. (NY) at a date not verified here, which may postdate the 2024 grant year.

name: PHARMAVITE LLC
emp_source: Form 5500 participants 4,912 (2023) for sponsor Otsuka America, Inc.; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Otsuka_Holdings
notes: Pharmavite (Nature Made) of West Hills, California has been owned by Tokyo-based Otsuka since 1989; its US plan is sponsored by Otsuka America with 4,912 participants and the Otsuka group employs tens of thousands worldwide. The grant supported the $200 million New Albany gummy plant begun in 2023.

name: ADS ALLIANCE DATA SYSTEMS

emp_source: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001101215&type=10-K; Form 5500 participants 20,130 (2019)
notes: ADS Alliance Data Systems is the Columbus card-services unit of Alliance Data, renamed Bread Financial in 2022, whose 10-Ks show roughly 20,000 employees in 2017 and about 7,500 in 2022. notes: Landlord LLC for the Toledo Innovation Center, a 107,000 sq ft former post office rehab sponsored by Fresno-based Bitwise Industries with Toledo nonprofit ProMedica, financed with NMTC allocations plus JobsOhio grant and loan support. Bitwise had about 900 employees when it furloughed all staff in May 2023 and entered Chapter 7 in June 2023; which JV partner controlled the LLC is not stated in the sources found.

name: BELLISIO FOODS INC
